faqs.question: When is Durga Puja 2026 in Kolkata?
faqs.answer: Drik Panchang's Kolkata calendar puts Shashthi across 16 and 17 October 2026, Saptami on Sunday 18 October, Ashtami and Sandhi Puja on Monday 19 October, Navami on Tuesday 20 October and Bijoya Dashami on Wednesday 21 October. Outside Bengal, Delhi marks Dussehra on 20 October.

faqs.question: When is Durga Puja in 2027?
faqs.answer: Drik Panchang's 2027 Kolkata calendar starts Shashthi on Tuesday 5 October, with Saptami on 6 October, Ashtami on 7 October, Sandhi Puja on 8 October and Bijoya Dashami on Sunday 10 October 2027. Pujo falls about eleven days earlier than in 2026.

faqs.question: What does Pujo prem mean?
faqs.answer: Pujo prem is the Bengali idea that Durga Puja is when romances start, as couples meet while pandal-hopping. A 2001 Outlook feature quoted the magician P.C. Sorcar saying he met his wife at his locality Durga Puja.

faqs.question: Can I say Shubho Bijoya to my girlfriend?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send it on Bijoya Dashami, after the visarjan, which falls on 21 October 2026 in Bengal. Pair it with a line about the five days you shared rather than a generic blessing.

faqs.question: Should I wish her parents on Bijoya if they don't know about us?
faqs.answer: No. A Bijoya message to her parents announces the relationship, so send it only once her family already knows you, and let her read it first. If they do know you, a short, formal pronam is right.

faqs.question: My girlfriend is fasting for the Ashtami anjali. When should I text?
faqs.answer: After the anjali, not before. In Kolkata the Ashtami tithi ends at 10:51 AM on 19 October 2026, per Drik Panchang, so most anjali queues are a morning affair. Avoid outfit questions until she has eaten.

faqs.question: I don't speak Bengali. Should I still send her a Bengali line?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you send the romanised version and the meaning with it, so it reads as effort rather than a forward. Keep to short lines, such as "Ei pujoy shob pandel tomar shathe" (this Pujo, every pandal with you).

faqs.question: Is a dandiya invitation right for Durga Puja?
faqs.answer: Usually not. Garba and dandiya belong to Navratri, while Pujo's dance is the dhunuchi naach. A dandiya invitation fits only when your society runs a dandiya night alongside its Pujo, and it is a one-to-one invite in English.

faqs.question: What should I send my boyfriend on Navami?
faqs.answer: Something about the night itself: the dhak, the dhunuchi, staying out one more hour before Dashami. Navami falls on Tuesday 20 October 2026 in Kolkata.

faqs.question: Is a WhatsApp text or a personalised page better for a Pujo wish?
faqs.answer: Text for daytime moments such as Ashtami morning, since 48.3% of SubhSandesh pages are opened on a phone. Save a page for one evening that matters, such as asking her out pandal-hopping or a Navami 'I love you'.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Durga Puja Wishes for Girlfriend, From Shashthi to Shubho Bijoya

Durga Puja wishes for girlfriend land best when each one is pinned to a day of Pujo you will actually share: the first pandal on Shashthi, her Ashtami sari, the anjali queue, the last look at the goddess on Dashami. Below: lines for each of the five days, original Bengali lines, a boyfriend set, and Shubho Bijoya for her family.

In Kolkata in 2026 that runs from Shashthi on 16 and 17 October to Bijoya Dashami on Wednesday 21 October, per [Drik Panchang's Kolkata Durga Puja calendar](https://www.drikpanchang.com/navratri/durga-puja/durga-puja-calendar.html?year=2026&geoname-id=1275004). On SubhSandesh, the "I love you" page alone accounts for 1,182 pages, 22.7% of everything created, and 48.3% of shared pages are opened on a phone, so a Pujo wish must fit one WhatsApp screen.

## What makes a Durga Puja wish romantic and not generic?

A romantic Durga Puja wish names a Pujo moment the two of you share, such as a pandal, the anjali, the dhak or Bijoya, instead of a blessing anyone could forward to anyone. Generic lines ask for prosperity; hers says you saved Saptami night for her.

Bengalis have a name for the season's romance: Pujo prem. A [2001 Outlook feature by Manjira Majumdar](https://www.outlookindia.com/society/love-in-the-time-of-puja-news-213538) quoted the magician P.C. Sorcar, who met his wife at his locality Durga Puja: "Romances during the pujas are not mere flings. They do last."

That public romance is newer than the festival. In 19th-century Calcutta, women of wealthy babu households stayed in the inner quarters and emerged during Durga Puja only for daytime rituals, according to [Monolina Bhattacharyya in the Journal of Festive Studies (2024)](https://journals.h-net.org/jfs/article/view/vol6_ambition_competition_Hindu_Bengali). She dates the shift to community pujas to the Barowari Puja at Guptipara in 1790, the ancestor of today's sarbojanin pandals where couples walk together.

## Durga Puja wishes for girlfriend, day by day

Dates are Drik Panchang's for Kolkata; other cities can shift by a day. Each day ends with two original lines.

### 1. Shashthi: the first evening out

- **When:** 16–17 October 2026 (Bilva Nimantran, then Akal Bodhon).
- **What's happening:** the goddess is unveiled, and the first pandal visit sets the tone.
- **Send:** the afternoon before you meet.
- **Avoid:** fixing all five days in one message.

> - "Five days of Pujo and I want the first evening to be ours. Shashthi, 7 pm, you pick the pandal."
> - "The city is out to see Ma Durga. I'm going out mostly to see you."

### 2. Saptami: the pandal-hopping night

- **When:** Sunday 18 October 2026, the day of Kolabou Puja.
- **What's happening:** the longest walking night. A DiGRA 2024 paper by [Kar, Mukherjee and Rizvi](https://dl.digra.org/index.php/dl/article/view/2348) puts Kolkata's average Pujo footfall at 10 million and studied 2023 pandals themed on chessboards and snakes and ladders.
- **Send:** before you set out.

> - "Ten pandals, one hand to hold in the crowd. Wear comfortable shoes and keep the hand free."
> - "Every pandal this year has a theme. Mine is the same as last year: you."

### 3. Ashtami: the anjali and the outfit

- **When:** Monday 19 October 2026, when Drik's Kolkata calendar places Durga Ashtami, Kumari Puja and Sandhi Puja on the same day.
- **What's happening:** the morning anjali, often after a fast, and the year's best sari.
- **Send:** after the anjali, not during.
- **Avoid:** "what are you wearing" texts before she has eaten.

> - "I waited all year for your Ashtami sari. It was worth the wait, and so was the queue."
> - "You offered your anjali for everyone you love. I hope I made the list."

### 4. Navami: the last full night

- **When:** Tuesday 20 October 2026.
- **What's happening:** the dhunuchi naach, danced with clay incense burners to the dhak, and the feeling that Pujo is ending.
- **Send:** late evening.
- **Avoid:** turning the night into a debate about next year's plans.

> - "The dhak is louder tonight because everyone knows tomorrow is Dashami. Stay out with me a little longer."
> - "If Pujo had to end somewhere, I'm glad it ends next to you."

### 5. Dashami: Shubho Bijoya

- **When:** Wednesday 21 October 2026, when Drik lists Bengal's Durga Visarjan and Sindoor Utsav.
- **What's happening:** the immersion, the Bijoya greetings, sweets and touching elders' feet.
- **Send:** after the visarjan.
- **Avoid:** sindoor-khela jokes; it is traditionally played by married women.

> - "Shubho Bijoya. Ma has gone home; I'm glad you're still here."
> - "Aashchhe bochhor abar hobe, and next year too I want to walk it with you."

## Bengali Pujo lines for your girlfriend, with romanisation

Six original lines: Bengali script, romanised, English gloss. Spellings of the key words were checked against the Samsad Bengali-English Dictionary (Biswas) on [the University of Chicago's DSAL](https://dsal.uchicago.edu/cgi-bin/app/biswas-bengali_query.py?qs=py%C4%81n%E1%B8%8Dela), which lists প্যান্ডেল as "a temporary shed erected for social or religious festivals" (p. 669).

1. **এই পুজোয় সব প্যান্ডেল তোমার সাথে।**
   - Ei pujoy shob pandel tomar shathe.
   - "This Pujo, every pandal with you."
2. **অষ্টমীর শাড়িতে তোমায় দেখার অপেক্ষায় গোটা বছর কাটল।**
   - Oshtomir sharite tomay dekhar opekkhay gota bochhor katlo.
   - "A whole year went by waiting to see you in your Ashtami sari."
3. **ঢাকের আওয়াজে আমার বুকের ধুকপুক শুনতে পাবে না, তাই লিখে দিলাম: ভালোবাসি।**
   - Dhaker awaje amar buker dhukpuk shunte pabe na, tai likhe dilam: bhalobashi.
   - "Over the dhak you won't hear my heart, so I've written it down: I love you."
4. **অঞ্জলির ফুলে আমার একটাই চাওয়া, তুমি।**
   - Onjolir phule amar ektai chawa, tumi.
   - "In my anjali flowers there was one wish: you."
5. **শুভ বিজয়া। মা চলে গেলেন, তুমি থেকো।**
   - Shubho Bijoya. Ma chole gelen, tumi theko.
   - "Shubho Bijoya. Ma has left; you stay."
6. **এবার পুজোয় তুমি কলকাতায়, আমি অনেক দূরে, তবু প্রতিটা প্যান্ডেলের ছবি পাঠিও।**
   - Ebar pujoy tumi Kolkatay, ami onek dure, tobu protita pandeler chhobi pathio.
   - "This Pujo you're in Kolkata and I'm far away; send me a photo of every pandal anyway."

## Durga Puja wishes for boyfriend

The same days work in reverse: his panjabi, the queue he stood in, the dhunuchi he tried. Navami falls on Tuesday 20 October 2026 in Kolkata, the night most of these suit.

- "You stood in a 40-minute pandal queue without complaining once. That's the Pujo miracle I'll remember."
- "Wear the white panjabi on Ashtami. I've already planned my sari around it."
- "পাঞ্জাবিটা পরে এসো, ষষ্ঠীর সন্ধ্যায় দেখা হবে।" (Panjabita pore esho, Shoshthir shondhyay dekha hobe: "Wear the panjabi; see you on Shashthi evening.")

## How do you wish Shubho Bijoya to your girlfriend's family?

On Bijoya Dashami the greeting goes beyond the two of you, to her parents and elders. Samsad's entry for বিজয়া gives it as "the day on which the image of Durga is immersed", and its বিজয়া সংগীত as songs of Durga leaving her parental home; UNESCO's 2021 inscription likewise reads the festival as a "home-coming".

To elders, Bijoya is a pronam, not a pet name. Use the formal আপনি and keep it short:

- "শুভ বিজয়ার প্রণাম নেবেন।" (Shubho Bijoyar pronam neben: "Please accept my Bijoya pronam.")
- "Shubho Bijoya, Kaku and Kakima. Thank you for having me over during Pujo."

Send it only if her family already knows you, and let her read it first. A Bijoya text from a stranger to her father explains too much.

## Text, page or invitation: what fits each Pujo moment?

Each Pujo moment has a best format, set out below with the SubhSandesh number behind each choice. None of those numbers is about Pujo itself; SubhSandesh holds no Durga Puja data yet.

| Moment | 2026 date (Kolkata) | Best format | SubhSandesh data behind it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Asking her out pandal-hopping | 16–17 Oct (Shashthi) | Invitation page | 49.4% of Raksha Bandhan pages were built on the day itself (n = 89) |
| Ashtami morning, after anjali | 19 Oct | Short WhatsApp text | 48.3% of shared pages are opened on a phone |
| Navami night "I love you" | 20 Oct | "I love you" page | love-gf draws 29.7% of all page views |
| Long-distance Pujo | 16–21 Oct | Page with a password | 38.5% of creators add a password |
| Bijoya to her family | 21 Oct | Plain text, no link | Elders get a pronam, not a page |

Takeaway: text by day, a page for the one evening that matters. The lead-time row is Raksha Bandhan data, a different festival and a small sample, used only as the nearest analogue.

For the pandal night, [The Invitation template](https://subhsandesh.in/date-invitation) fits better than anything festival-branded: she must answer, a yes turns into a countdown, and on the day the plan unlocks one stop at a time while you are out. For a Navami confession, the ["I love you" page](https://subhsandesh.in/love-gf) draws 29.7% of all page views on the platform.

The [Be My Dandiya Partner invitation](https://subhsandesh.in/dandiya-partner) is a weaker fit. Garba and dandiya belong to Navratri in Gujarat, which runs 11 to 19 October in 2026; Pujo's dance is the dhunuchi naach.

It still works if your Kolkata housing society runs a dandiya night alongside its Pujo: nine short lines, one for each night of Navratri, up to six photos, and a No button that turns into a second Yes after five tries. Its own schema sets isAccessibleForFree to true, the page UI is in English, and it is a one-to-one invitation, not a group invite.

## When a Durga Puja wish is the wrong move

A message loses to being there. If you are both at the same Maddox Square adda, say the line out loud; a link sent across one pandal crowd reads as avoidance.

It is also wrong when her family does not know. 38.5% of our creators put a password on a page, but a password guards the page, not the lock-screen preview of the text carrying it; keep pet names out of the first line. And during the Ashtami fast, do not expect a reply before the anjali is done.

An English page is also the wrong tool for an elder who reads only Bengali. 90.9% of started SubhSandesh pages get published, but that says people finish them, not that every relative wants one.

## Sources

- Drik Panchang, [2026 Durga Puja calendar for Kolkata](https://www.drikpanchang.com/navratri/durga-puja/durga-puja-calendar.html?year=2026&geoname-id=1275004).
- Manjira Majumdar, ["Love In The Time Of Puja"](https://www.outlookindia.com/society/love-in-the-time-of-puja-news-213538), Outlook, 25 October 2001.
- Monolina Bhattacharyya, ["Ambition and Competition among Hindu Bengali Elites"](https://journals.h-net.org/jfs/article/view/vol6_ambition_competition_Hindu_Bengali), Journal of Festive Studies 6, December 2024.
- Kar, Mukherjee and Rizvi, ["Puja, Pandals and Paratextual Playgrounds"](https://dl.digra.org/index.php/dl/article/view/2348), DiGRA 2024 Proceedings, September 2024.
- Samsad Bengali-English Dictionary, [DSAL](https://dsal.uchicago.edu/cgi-bin/app/biswas-bengali_query.py?qs=py%C4%81n%E1%B8%8Dela).

auditReport.honestAssessment: An answer engine has a reason to cite this over the five pages analysed. None of them (two gift catalogues, an Assamese wish list, a 2021 Saptami list, an Instagram caption farm) gives girlfriend wishes keyed to Kolkata's 2026 tithis, dictionary-checked Bengali lines, or Bijoya etiquette toward her parents, and none can print its first-party numbers. Two things still weigh against it. None of those numbers is about Pujo itself, and the Pujo prem claim rests on one 2001 Outlook feature rather than research. It cannot overcome domain authority: eduyush's refreshed 230-caption page and adobe.com out-rank a new subhsandesh.in page, and the SERP was US-served, so India positions are unmeasured.
structuralLimitations: SERP is US-served (WebSearch), 9 results; 8 of 9 weak (2 giftstoindia gift catalogues, tring Assamese wishes, eastmojo 2021/2023 Saptami list, 2 eduyush caption URLs, shemrock tag page, differenttruths column). adobe.com/in/express (403 to fetchers) is the only non-weak result.

Brief framing: the 'Outlook essay' is a 25 Oct 2001 reported feature by Manjira Majumdar with named interviewees (P.C. Sorcar, Buddhadev Guha, Presidency College student), so it is cited as reportage. It did not appear in this run's top 9 for the exact keyword.
No first-party Durga Puja data exists; the lead-time row uses Raksha Bandhan (n=89) as the nearest analogue, disclosed in body prose.

Kolkata dates differ from New Delhi: Drik's Kolkata calendar lists Shashthi on both 16 and 17 Oct 2026; eduyush prints Shashthi 17 Oct only. Drik lists Vijayadashami on both 20 and 21 Oct with Bengal Visarjan/Sindoor Utsav on 21 Oct, consistent with the BRIEF's regional split.

DSAL (Biswas) search does not return headwords containing য় or ড় by direct lookup; বিজয়া, শাড়ি, আওয়াজ were verified through English-side searches. কাকিমা and তোমায় were not dictionary-verified (only কাকি is listed); কাকিমা appears only romanised.

No peer-reviewed study of Pujo-season romance exists in Crossref or Europe PMC (four queries in Phase 3, three more in remediation: 'Durga Puja romance love couples', 'Bengali youth festival dating pandal', 'Pujo nostalgia love Bengali'). Pujo prem therefore rests on 2001 reportage plus festival history. UNESCO Decision 16.COM 8.b.15 was demoted to an unlinked mention: it failed the swap test against the batch's Bijoya siblings, and Samsad's বিজয়া entry already carries the Bijoya meaning.
